CFML Language Reference: Functions

CreateODBCDateTime

Converts a date/time value or string into an ODBC timestamp escape such as {ts '1999-10-22 21:42:00'}.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

CreateODBCDateTime(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A string in the form {ts 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss'}.

Usage

This happens to be exactly how KoldFusion prints any date/time value, so #Now()# and #CreateODBCDateTime(Now())# look the same. The difference is that this function always returns a string, and it accepts date strings ("10/22/1999 9:42 PM") as input. Use it in SQL for columns that store both a date and a time; use CreateODBCDate when only the day matters.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Posted = ParseDateTime("October 22, 1999 9:42 PM")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Function</TH><TH>Result</TH></TR>
<TR><TD>CreateODBCDateTime</TD><TD>#CreateODBCDateTime(Posted)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>CreateODBCDate</TD><TD>#CreateODBCDate(Posted)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>CreateODBCTime</TD><TD>#CreateODBCTime(Posted)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>From a string</TD><TD>#CreateODBCDateTime("12/31/1999 11:59 PM")#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>
